value.rationale: Provides an exact all-finite-horizon sharp rate and tie-induced parity law for existing quantile-projection algorithms on perfectly conditioned frames, with a rank-one absorption transition and fixed-rank quadratic slowdown. This is a concrete structural numerical-analysis benchmark that general condition-number arguments do not characterize.
